§6Jetpack Tiers§f

§aTime to ditch the elytra and strap a rocket to your chest.§f
Iron Jetpacks gives you RF-powered flight via chestplate jetpacks. Upgrade through five active tiers (several vanilla tiers like Wood, Stone, Gold, Diamond, and Emerald are §cdisabled§f in this pack).

§6Active Tiers§f:
§b• Copper§f (Tier 1): §e250,000 RF§f buffer, §c85 FE/t§f usage.
§b• Bronze §f/ §bIron§f (Tier 2): §e800,000 RF§f, §c120 FE/t§f. Both share identical flight stats.
§b• Steel §f/ §bInvar§f (Tier 3): §e12,000,000 RF§f, §c350 FE/t§f. Steel is slightly faster vertically; both have enchantability 15.
§b• Electrum§f (Tier 3 alt): §e10,000,000 RF§f, §c310 FE/t§f. Fastest Tier 3 in the air, but lower capacity.
§b• Platinum§f (Tier 4): §e36,000,000 RF§f, §c720 FE/t§f. The endgame package.

§6Upgrading§f:
Place your current jetpack in the center slot, surround it with the next tier's metal ingots, two §bcoils§f (Basic for lower tiers, Advanced for higher), a capacitor, and a leather strap. Energy is §apreserved across upgrades§f.

§ePS:§f Coils shift from Basic to Advanced once you hit the midpoint of the tier list. Check JEI for exact recipes.
